name: Kamimoto Haruka
source: The protagonist. Haruka is a carefree male high school student who lives by himself due to his parents living overseas in order to study ancient ruins. Fawned over by Nagisa and hated by Mirai, Haruka's luck in relationships triggers the strange events to come. One day receiving a mysterious pot from his parents, Haruka, while  frustrated with his current state of affairs, inadvertently influences the arrival of a bizarre visitor.
